thread:
sophia li: Hey team — quick Q. I booked travel on the company card, got only a digital boarding pass (no printed receipt). Airline refunded $47 for a seat-change after the trip and the refund descriptor on the statement is just 'TRAVEL CR' which doesn't match the original charge. How should I submit this so finance can reconcile?
maria k.: Do you have the refund email from the airline and the boarding pass screenshot? We usually need either an itemized receipt or a clear refund notice + the original charge line on the statement.
sophia li: I have the refund email and a screenshot of the boarding pass. The problem is the statement shows two lines: 'AIRLINE 1234 $512.00' and later 'TRAVEL CR -$47.00' with no reservation code.
anton d.: If the refund descriptor doesn't match, finance asks for a short attestation explaining it plus the airline confirmation. Upload both and tag @finance. Also paste a snippet of the bank statement highlighting both lines.
sophia li: ok uploading now. Do I need to adjust the expense amount in Concur/Expensify or just attach docs?
people-ops: For company-card charges, leave the expense amount as the original charge. Add an attachment named "refund_explanation.pdf" with: 1) airline refund email 2) boarding pass screenshot 3) a one-paragraph note explaining the descriptor mismatch and linking to reservation ID. Finance uses that to net the refund on their side.
finance-bot: Automated rule — when a refund amount < 10% of charge and documentation attached, expense remains unchanged. Finance will process a reconciliation entry during bookkeeping close.
sophia li: Thanks. One more: does a partial refund that reduces airfare affect per-diem or hotel reimbursement? Example: cancelled final leg, refunded seat fee and we still stayed same nights.
maria k.: No — per-diem is based on actual travel days and hotel stays; minor fee refunds (seat/ancillary) don't change per-diem. If a full segment is cancelled and you didn't travel that day, submit a corrected itinerary + hotel cancellation, and we'll pro-rate per-diem.
anton d.: If the refund was credited back to the company card and Finance reconciles, you don't need to ask for extra approval. If you charged any personal card because of the change, tag people-ops and attach the receipts for reimbursement.
sophia li: Perfect. Upload complete and I tagged @finance. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
finance-bot: Received — ticket #FIN-4821 created. Please allow 3-5 business days for reconciliation. If anything is missing Finance will ping in-thread.
maria k.: Noted — will add a short update to the travel FAQ about boarding-pass-only cases and mismatched descriptors. Might include a sample attestation text to speed things up.
sophia li: Great, that would help future trips. Appreciate it!
